title: Rouling aytishicha, 12 nashriyot Garri Potterni rad etgan

scenes.text: O'n ikki marta rad javobini olsang, to'xtarmiding?
scenes.keywords: woman walking rainy city street with folder

scenes.text: Joan Rouling Garri Potter haqidagi birinchi kitobini nashriyotlarga yubordi.
Uning aytishicha, o'n ikki nashriyot kitobni rad etgan.
scenes.keywords: woman opening letters at desk disappointed

scenes.text: 1997 yilda Bloomsbury nashriyoti kitobni chop etdi.
Bugun bu turkum dunyodagi eng ko'p sotilgan kitoblar qatorida.
Sen qaysi birini tanlaysan: yana bir urinishnimi yoki to'xtashnimi?
scenes.keywords: young man walking forward city sunrise

description: Joan Rouling aytishicha, Garri Potter haqidagi birinchi kitobini o'n ikki nashriyot rad etgan. 1997 yilda Bloomsbury kitobni chop etdi va turkum dunyodagi eng ko'p sotilgan kitoblar qatoriga kirdi.
source: Fact-checked 2026-11-07 (fixed: 12 rejections now attributed to Rowling's account; it is her/biographers' widely repeated figure, not an independently audited count). Christian Science Monitor on Rowling's 2010 Oprah interview, 12 rejections before Bloomsbury: https://m.csmonitor.com/Books/chapter-and-verse/2010/1004/J.K.-Rowling-Harry-Potter-is-quite-a-good-story ; Bloomsbury published Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone on 26 June 1997 (Britannica: J.K. Rowling; Biography.com https://www.biography.com/authors-writers/a99894286/jk-rowling-harry-potter-facts ); series sales over 500 million copies (Bloomsbury / Guinness World Records).
